name: aws-cost-audit
description: Read-only AWS cost audit that ends in a phased cuts plan: the bill classified into fixed categories, the biggest lines, what can be cut now, what needs engineering, what needs architecture or contract changes, with a monthly savings forecast and the production impact of every action. Works with or without Kubernetes. It never changes the account.

payer_profile.title: AWS CLI profile of the payer account
payer_profile.description: The consolidated-billing (management) account. Cost Explorer run here sees every linked account; run from a member account it sees only that one.

member_profiles.title: AWS CLI profiles of the accounts to inspect
member_profiles.description: Comma-separated, e.g. prod-infra,staging. Leave blank if everything lives in the payer account.

region.title: Main region
region.description: Where the workloads run, e.g. us-east-1. Cost Explorer is global; CloudWatch and EC2 calls use this.

kube_context.title: kubectl context of the production cluster (optional)
kube_context.description: Only if there is an EKS cluster. Leave blank for ECS, plain EC2 or serverless accounts.

timezone_offset.title: Local timezone offset for hour-of-day profiles
timezone_offset.description: Hours from UTC, e.g. -3 for Brasilia, -5 for New York, 1 for Berlin. Peaks and off-peak windows are reported in this zone.
